nodes.klein: to be coupled together, be doubled, to match, fit, be suitable; to bear twins; to be adjoining; to adapt, adjust. was coupled together, was doubled (in the Bible occurring in the form of the part.); he resembled, corresponded. was suitable. he coordinated. was coordinated. (f.) she bore twins (in the Bible occurring only Cant. 4:2 and 6:6 in the phrase שֶׁכֻּלָּם מַתְאִימוֹת, ‘whereof everyone bears twins’); he fitted, suited, conformed, adapted; was fit, was suited, was adapted. was found in the middle between two things; was made double, was doubled; was made to be fitted, was made to suit, was made to be adjusted to.

to be empty, be clear, be pure, be free, be innocent, be desolate, be cut off
